# Tax Practice AI & Automation RFP Template

> RFP template, evaluation scorecard, AI capability checklist, and implementation roadmap for tax practices selecting AI automation vendors — including Circular 230 compliance, EA/CPA credential positioning, distress-driven intake automation, and tax-practice-specific AI deployment requirements.

## About This Resource

This repository provides a comprehensive, vendor-neutral framework for tax practices evaluating AI automation solutions. Unlike generic AI RFPs, this resource is built specifically for the unique compliance, credential, and operational requirements of tax practices.

### Key Differentiators

**Tax-Specific Compliance:**
- IRS Circular 230 compliance requirements for AI-generated tax advice
- TCPA compliance for AI voice agents and SMS automation
- YMYL (Your Money or Your Life) content standards for tax content
- Credential-aware AI deployment (EA, CPA, JD distinctions)

**Distress-Driven Buyer Psychology:**
- Tax clients often arrive in crisis (IRS notices, audit notifications, levy threats)
- AI systems must prioritize after-hours availability and urgency triage
- Intake must be compressed (3-field mobile forms, not 15-field web forms)
- Trust signals must be immediate (credential display, clear specialization)

**Seasonality Constraints:**
- No AI launches during busy season (January–April)
- Ideal deployment windows: May–July, August–October
- AI must handle 3x traffic spikes during tax season
- Workload forecasting for capacity planning

**What's Included:**
- RFP Template (800+ lines): 11-section RFP with tax-practice-specific requirements
- Evaluation Scorecard (300+ lines): 8-criteria weighted scoring with domain expertise
- AI Capability Checklist (350+ lines): 14-section technical checklist (122 items)
- Implementation Roadmap (500+ lines): 4-phase plan with seasonality timing

### Who This Is For

- Tax practice owners and managing partners evaluating AI vendors
- Enrolled Agents (EAs), CPAs, and tax attorneys automating client intake
- Practice administrators building RFP processes for AI procurement
- Advisory committees evaluating vendor proposals

### Who This Is NOT For

- Practices looking for cheap, quick-fix solutions
- Practices expecting instant results (proper deployment takes 4–6 months)
- Practices unwilling to invest in compliance-aware implementation
- Practices in January–April busy season (plan for off-season deployment)
